trust_decision.summary: Bytes read from the artifact store are passed to cloudpickle.load with no check; the fix trusts them only if their sha256 matches the content_hash recorded in the ZenML DB at save time.

landing_point.why: The advisory names CloudpickleMaterializer; its load() is the single cloudpickle.load call.

fix_sites.entry_point: any artifact load whose recorded materializer is CloudpickleMaterializer or a subclass (Sklearn, Langchain)
artifact save (save_artifact / step outputs) -> hash computed during dump, returned by compute_content_hash
fix_sites.module_kind: materializer save path (producer of recorded hash)

fix_sites.entry_point: helper CallbackWriter in src/zenml/utils/io_utils.py used by save

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/zenml/materializers/cloudpickle_materializer.py:111-114 with src/zenml/artifacts/utils.py:195 (the save path must produce the hash that the load check needs; base compute_content_hash returns None at src/zenml/materializers/base_materializer.py:232-241, which would silently disable the check)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about loading; save-side hashing looks like an unrelated feature, and with content_hash None the check falls back to legacy unchecked loading so tests of the load-only fix on fresh artifacts can look green only if the solver also writes the hash.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Artifacts saved before the fix (no recorded content_hash) must still load; the fix keeps an unchecked fallback, and a test asserts it. Also a non-None content_hash now feeds the step cache key.

O6_input_shapes: artifact with no recorded hash (legacy, unchecked)

O7_producer.where: src/zenml/materializers/cloudpickle_materializer.py:111-114 and src/zenml/artifacts/utils.py:195 (compute_content_hash after save, stored via src/zenml/zen_stores/schemas/artifact_schemas.py:500)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Container artifacts (list/tuple/dict of non-JSON objects): each element is saved by the fallback CloudpickleMaterializer in a subfolder; the outer hash is None and element materializers are built without expected_content_hash, so elements are unpickled unchecked.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Nested container elements look like a separate built-in materializer feature; outer compute_content_hash returns None for non-serializable data (src/zenml/materializers/built_in_materializer.py:543-553) so there is no recorded hash to pass down.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Chunked/mapped step input: BuiltInContainerMaterializer.load_item builds the element materializer from metadata in the artifact store with no hash.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dynamic-pipeline chunk loading is a neighbouring feature; step_runner sets the hash only on the outer materializer (fix.diff:178) before load_item at src/zenml/orchestrators/step_runner.py:620.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file and package from landing point (materializers vs orchestrators)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Materializer identity comes from artifact-store files: metadata.json in containers and the model metadata YAML name the materializer class via source_utils.load, so a store writer can pick a materializer that ignores expected_content_hash.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fix passes the hash through this function so it looks covered; the materializer-name swap is a parser/identity differential, not a cloudpickle call.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file (artifacts/utils.py) and the container case in src/zenml/materializers/built_in_materializer.py:406-409

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Second implementation of pickle loading from the artifact store: BasePyTorchMaterializer uses torch.load(weights_only=False) with no hash check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different integration, marked '# nosec' with a comment that it is intended for trusted data; advisory names only CloudpickleMaterializer.
